t: The Wizarding Tiers of Tech: A Philosophy of Editors and Languages
s: This article explores the historical and philosophical evolution of software development through the lens of influential figures, their chosen text editors (vi/vim vs. Emacs), and the languages that define different tiers of technical mastery and impact.
sub: The 'Wizarding Tiers' hierarchy: Architects (Thompson, Stallman), Master Builders (Torvalds, van Rossum), System Weavers (DHH).
The philosophical divide between vi/vim (minimalist, modal, instrumental) and Emacs (maximalist, extensible, operating system-like).
Evolution of programming languages from foundational (C, LISP) to modern (Python, Rust), and their roles in the development landscape.
The 'alignment battle' between modern IDEs like VS Code and traditional editors like Neovim, framed within the vi/Emacs legacy.
